title: Doubling flag of a call segment
statement: Let a call specification have a mode and an ordered list of argument registers, and let $x$ be a Boolean input and $W$ assign a Boolean word to each register. For any index $s$ strictly less than one plus the number of argument registers, the flag indicating whether segment $s$ is doubled equals the second component of segment $s$ in the list formed from the mode's initial segment and the argument segments.
